measure: Spring hang test, each spring: hang 1, 2, 3 kg and measure the length each time (hooks included). python calib.py spring FREE_MM 1:MM 2:MM 3:MM, then SPRING k_n_per_mm and F0_n (mean of the two); the stronger spring decides the anchor holes (MEASURE_LIST B4). Every range number scales with the stored energy.

Wiper (MEASURE_LIST A6): free speed and current from a 40 % bench jog in telemetry, then WIPER n0_rpm = jog rpm x 2.5 (never the raw jog rpm) and free_a = amps. The stall cannot be read (jogs trip at 2.5 to 3 A, A7): keep stall_nm and stall_a.
Dart mass on a kitchen scale with ballast and tether knot (spec 0.279 kg), then DART mass_kg.

Payout brake (MEASURE_LIST G4, hanging weights: a luggage scale cannot read this low): in LAUNCH 40 g on the line must not pull line off and 50 g must (LIGHT 0.5 N); in NEUTRAL the FIRM clutch (5 N) lets line off at about 0.5 kg on the luggage scale.
First shots on level ground: python calib.py range pitch:brake:range ..., then LAUNCH v_scale = FACTOR.
